skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept and role of labour organization and standardization in organizations.
Understand the principles and significance of labour organization and standardization in organizations.
Understand the trends of labour organization and standardization in a market economy and international integration.
Understand and apply time study methods for labor organization.
Understand and apply concepts of labor division and cooperation in organizations.
Understand and apply concepts of workplace organization in organizations.
Understand and apply concepts of labor condition improvement in organizations.
Demonstrate effective communication skills through writing and presenting.
Demonstrate problem-solving skills related to labor organization and standardization.
